Man-Up order picker (HLO) - Den Hoorn - 
 €15.00 per uur - Logistics - 36 hour 
Do you want to work as an HLO (Man Up) order picker at the large logistics company Van der Helm? 
The work is done with a high Combi Truck. The employee sits in the cabin of the machine. The cabin is large enough so that the employee has room to sit and move safely. The machine can go very high, up to 12-16 meters. The employee goes up together with the cabin. Before the employee goes up, he places an empty pallet on the forks. Sometimes there is a full pallet on the forks if it needs to be placed in the racking. 
When you are high in the air, you pick boxes from the shelves by hand. The boxes can weigh between 15 and 20 kilos, depending on the product. The employee puts the boxes on the empty pallet or places full pallets in the racking. After finishing the work, the machine goes down. The employee drives the truck to another location in the warehouse. 
 Job Requirements 
 - HLO (Man Up) certificate or willing to get it - Not afraid to work in height - Physicaly ready to work - English speaking - Detailed orientated
